rules.title: Access Control for Applications
rules.summary: Public endpoints should enforce access control and authentication policies.

iso_rule.subject: User
iso_rule.description: Access to application endpoints must be controlled and require authentication

rules.title: Event Logging
rules.summary: Security events should be logged to record actions that could affect information security.

iso_rule.subject: System
iso_rule.description: Event logging should capture actions affecting information security

rules.title: Cryptography (Weak Hash)
rules.summary: Cryptographic controls should avoid weak hash algorithms such as MD5 and SHA-1.

iso_rule.subject: System
iso_rule.description: Cryptographic controls should avoid weak hash algorithms such as MD5 and SHA-1

rules.title: Cryptography (Weak Cipher)
rules.summary: Cryptographic controls should avoid weak or deprecated ciphers and insecure modes.

iso_rule.subject: System
iso_rule.description: Cryptographic controls should avoid weak ciphers and insecure modes

rules.title: Cryptography (Insecure Randomness)
rules.summary: Security-sensitive code should use cryptographically strong randomness rather than predictable PRNGs.

iso_rule.subject: System
iso_rule.description: Security-sensitive code should avoid predictable randomness sources (e.g., java.util.Random)

rules.title: Secure Development (SQL Injection)
rules.reference: Pragmatic mapping for OWASP Benchmark evaluation
rules.summary: Application code should prevent SQL injection by avoiding dynamic query construction with untrusted input.

iso_rule.subject: Developer
iso_rule.description: Application code should prevent SQL injection by avoiding dynamic SQL concatenation with untrusted input

rules.title: Secure Development (Path Traversal)
rules.reference: Pragmatic mapping for OWASP Benchmark evaluation
rules.summary: Application code should prevent path traversal by avoiding direct file path construction from untrusted input.

iso_rule.subject: Developer
iso_rule.description: Application code should prevent path traversal by avoiding direct file path construction from untrusted input

rules.title: Secure Development (Command Injection)
rules.reference: Pragmatic mapping for OWASP Benchmark evaluation
rules.summary: Application code should prevent command injection by avoiding shell or process command construction from untrusted input.

iso_rule.subject: Developer
iso_rule.description: Application code should prevent command injection by avoiding shell or process command construction from untrusted input

rules.title: Secure Development (LDAP Injection)
rules.reference: Pragmatic mapping for OWASP Benchmark evaluation
rules.summary: Application code should prevent LDAP injection by avoiding concatenated LDAP filter construction with untrusted input.

iso_rule.subject: Developer
iso_rule.description: Application code should prevent LDAP injection by avoiding concatenated LDAP filter construction with untrusted input

rules.title: Secure Development (XPath Injection)
rules.reference: Pragmatic mapping for OWASP Benchmark evaluation
rules.summary: Application code should prevent XPath injection by avoiding concatenated XPath expression construction with untrusted input.

iso_rule.subject: Developer
iso_rule.description: Application code should prevent XPath injection by avoiding concatenated XPath expression construction with untrusted input
